evals.prompt: Use my private Folio to brief me on the Canadian economy this week. Prefer Canadian reporting and include a few contrasting perspectives.
evals.expected_output: Checks authorized execution and credentials without exposing them; explains literal OR metadata discovery, selects relevant feeds in at most two bounded rounds, ranks/deduplicates candidates, saves only the shortlist, polls with call ID, binds latest to the completed job and verifies/read files before cited synthesis. Does not treat a Reuters Canada all-stories locale edition as Canada-only reporting; rediscovers changed IDs/versions rather than reusing stale plans. Reports partial-week coverage and never treats catalog compatibility as guaranteed. Keeps validated reads pinned if a newer folder becomes latest; stops incomplete on a snapshot 409 instead of mixing snapshots. Bases a new briefing on selected-job files, distinguishing unrelated same-folder files.

evals.prompt: Give me my Folio daily briefing now, and I would like this every day at 7am.
evals.expected_output: Uses ten Main feeds for a current briefing, selects rather than bulk collects, verifies selected saved files and reports limitations. Does not claim recurrence exists; asks timezone and requires a separately available scheduling mechanism/confirmation.

evals.prompt: Use Folio for today's energy news. This chat has code execution but outbound HTTP is disabled, and I cannot configure secrets here.
evals.expected_output: Stops live workflow, does not request/publish a hash or attempt bypasses; explains skills do not grant network/secrets. Offers analysis of uploaded credential-free Folio outputs or an authorized local runner. Does not fabricate retrieval, saving or scheduling.

evals.prompt: My completed Folio batch has a per-article upstream 403 and an unsupported-site error. The other saved files pass all checksums and say partial=false: one contains Jina Markdown reporting, another is only an archive picker. Should you rotate my Folio key or rerun the batch through Freedium? Brief me using the usable evidence.
evals.expected_output: Distinguishes per-article upstream errors from request-level Folio authentication failures; does not request or rotate credentials, wrap URLs, fetch publishers directly or replay saves to force a method. Inspects the job-bound verified files; accepts substantive Jina Markdown only after exact-byte verification and rejects the archive picker as unusable despite matching checksums and partial=false. Reports content-quality and extraction gaps separately from integrity checks. Cites original publisher URLs, not sourceUrl service/snapshot URLs; does not treat snapshot dates as publication dates or claim universal service availability. Produces only stories supported by usable selected-job reporting, with no invented article details if content is not supplied.
